Home.heroTitle: Build machine learning models with a visual workflow
Home.heroSubtitle: HAutoML helps users configure data, train, compare, and deploy models in an automation-canvas experience.
Home.statsIntro: An AutoML platform for research, learning, and fast model deployment experiments.
Home.workflowTitle: From dataset to deployed model in one flow
Home.workflowBody: The new homepage highlights what HAutoML does best: turning machine learning pipelines into observable, stateful, and adjustable steps.

realData.title: Start with real data
realData.body: Upload CSV or Excel files, inspect schema, choose the prediction column, and normalize data in one workflow.

pipeline.title: Track pipelines visually
pipeline.body: The progress map shows data reading, preprocessing, hyperparameter optimization, feature generation, and model evaluation.

deploy.title: Deploy the winning model
deploy.body: Leaderboard, insight panel, and test upload help you pick the champion model and use it faster.

Home.marketplaceTitle: Choose a template, tune parameters, run the pipeline
Home.marketplaceBody: Marketplace is the starting point for common tasks: classification, regression, churn prediction, and model testing.
Home.productTitle: An automation platform built for machine learning
Home.productBody: Users can quickly understand model state: reading data, optimizing parameters, which pipeline performs best, and how to test it.
Home.introBodySuffix: This is a student research project from the School of Information and Communications Technology, Hanoi University of Industry.
Home.introLowCode: The system focuses on low-code and no-code workflows, helping non-technical users build, evaluate, and use machine learning models.
Home.aboutBody: OptivisionLab focuses on artificial intelligence, connecting academic research with practical applications in education, healthcare, and industry.
Home.footerDescription: An open-source AutoML platform for research, learning, and faster machine learning workflows.
Home.address: Hanoi University of Industry, 298 Cau Dien Street, Minh Khai Ward, Bac Tu Liem District, Hanoi
